items.source: Creates a MappingMongoConverter using the configured AbstractMongoClientConfiguration.mongoDbFactory() and MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes).
items.translation: 使用配置的 MappingMongoConverter 和 AbstractMongoClientConfiguration.mongoDbFactory()、 MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes) 创建该转换器。

items.source: Creates a MappingMongoConverter using the configured AbstractReactiveMongoConfiguration.reactiveMongoDbFactory() and MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes).
items.translation: 使用配置的 MappingMongoConverter 和 AbstractReactiveMongoConfiguration.reactiveMongoDbFactory()、 MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes) 创建该转换器。

items.source: Register custom Converters in a CustomConversions object if required.
items.translation: 如果需要使用，可在 CustomConversions 对象中注册自定义的 Converter。

items.source: Functional style CustomConversions creation giving users a convenient way of configuring store specific capabilities by providing deferred hooks to what will be configured when creating the instance.
items.translation: 功能风格通过创建CustomConversions，为用户提供了一种便捷的方式来配置存储特定的功能，通过提供延迟钩子来实现对创建instance时将进行配置的延迟处理。

items.source: Creates a MongoMappingContext equipped with entity classes scanned from the mapping base package.
items.translation: 创建一个MongoMappingContext，该上下文已配备从映射基础包扫描的实体类。
